settings.title: Our Story
settings.description:
Monument Grills was founded in Atlanta by three friends who grew up
grilling together. Inspired by American traditions and a love for community,
we set out to create durable, high-performance grills.
Designed for everyday gatherings, our grills bring people together and
help turn great food into lasting memories

settings.title: Our Mission
settings.description:
To empower Monument Grillers to create extraordinary meals and cherished
moments with family and friends. We design innovative, 
high-performance grills that blend durability, ease, and excellence, making every
barbecue a celebration of community and craft. Our commitment is to
elevate outdoor cooking, fostering a passionate community that shares
in the joy of grilling done right.

settings.title: Our Vision
settings.description:
To redefine outdoor grilling as a cornerstone of American life,
crafting grills that inspire joy, connection, and culinary creativity. 
We aim to lead the industry with uncompromising quality and innovation,
uniting Monument Grillers in a shared legacy of unforgettable
gatherings and exceptional flavors.
